fixture: MNEMON_CLI_PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin/mnemon pnpm e2e:serve --exact-id. Only the delegated workers decisions are scripted: the remember worker writes the content it is given, the forget worker calls mnemon_forget with the exact id it is given. The baseline swaps main's Memory Spaces Source, service and adapter types and the Mnemon Native driver into the same build.
procedure: In a Mnemon E2E conversation: /mnemon remember Issue 337 synthetic fact: the staging rollout gate closes at 18:00 on release days.
/mnemon recall staging rollout gate, and read the id it prints.
/mnemon forget <ID>, then read the Native store status read-only.
